_about: API-STANDARD S2/S14 (slice 1a): the legacy keys each route answered BEFORE the standard, frozen. A Problem body adds fields beside these and never changes them. Recorded from the code before the change (tests/api-problem.test.cjs --capture); tests/api-problem.test.cjs replays every answer and compares status and keys. The generator copies a route entry into its OpenAPI operation as x-legacy-keys. A route drops its entry only when the web repo no longer reads any of its keys and cb-api has signed backward_compatible.
